parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the PolarDB instance on which the application depends.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

Default value: 30.

parameters.name: QuotaMode
parameters.description:
The query mode. Valid values:

-  **quotaPolicy**: quota rule
- **quota**: quota
